title: Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

reading.body:
An autonomous vehicle operated by Avride struck and killed a duck nesting near a restaurant in Austin, Texas. A human safety operator was present in the vehicle during the incident. The vehicle did not brake or attempt to avoid the duck.

The failure was in object detection and response. The system either did not recognize the duck as an obstacle or did not treat it as one requiring evasive action. A safety operator present in the vehicle did not intervene. What would have caught this is either better training of the perception system to detect small animals on roadways, or a safety protocol requiring human override authority when the system encounters potential obstacles it does not recognize.

It is not established whether the vehicle's failure to stop at a stop sign occurred, as the company's data review did not confirm this allegation.

reports.title: A self-driving car in Texas hit and killed a mother duck, sparking neighborhood outrage
Residents say self-driving car killed duck in Mueller
Self-driving car runs over Mueller Lake Park duck, raising safety concerns
Mueller residents upset after self-driving car runs over, kills duck

summary:
An autonomous vehicle operated by Avride in Austin, Texas struck and killed a mother duck in the Mueller Lake neighborhood, prompting significant community backlash. The duck was nesting in a pot outside a local restaurant, making it familiar to residents who discovered the incident through a social media post. The resident claimed the self-driving car did not slow down or stop after hitting the duck, and also alleged it failed to stop at a stop sign. Avride confirmed the vehicle was operating autonomously with a human safety operator present at the time.

In response to the incident, Avride reviewed vehicle data and found no evidence supporting the stop sign claim, stating the vehicle stopped appropriately at all relevant signs. The company has adjusted its testing operations by excluding certain streets around the lake from its service area. Avride is now conducting simulation experiments to improve the technology and prevent similar incidents in the future while maintaining safety performance. Local residents have preserved the duck's eggs in an incubator. Other companies including Waymo, Tesla, and Zoox continue operating autonomous vehicles in Austin.
